title: Enhancing functional and structural properties of chia seed flour through combined pH shifting and high-speed homogenization

Chia seed flour (CSF) is valued for its nutritional richness and functional attributes; however, its dark colour, high water absorption, and viscosity limit its application in leavened and other processed foods.
